method.selection: Visually identified 8-column by10-row coplanar stud grid on left foundation. Crop original image [30,340,420,610]. Four-neighbor connected bright cap regions; no page upsampling in measurement.
method.validation: Three held-out checkerboard folds, (column+row)%3. Fit six-parameter affine and eight-parameter homography to training centers; evaluate unseen centers. Separately fit light and dark plate sections to test whether the seam alone explains the improvement.
assumptions: all indexed top caps are on the same layer
limits: Threshold sweep is not a statistical confidence interval.
Held-out points come from one image, not independent books.
Homography advantage does not identify lens intrinsics or prove a specific 3D camera.
Potential source-image warp and geometry assumptions remain.

interpretation: Projective mapping predicts held-out cap centers substantially better across all tested thresholds and both plate sections. The orthographic inverse angle is an apparent value, not an accepted camera calibration. No camera/rendering defaults changed.
